content.rendered:
Kindergarten had a special visit from KGW meteorologist Rod Hill to learn all about wind and weather! Check it out below:

Students learned all about what causes wind and what tools meteorologists use to measure wind. They also created their own windsocks with help from Mr. Hill. They ended with singing “The Weather Song.” What a fun day!
